info.title: Astra independently authored DEMO API
info.description: Independently authored contracts for all 47 services, immutable office-specific fee assessments, and bKash v2 online checkout with provider verification, stored receipts and gateway reconciliation. These are not reference-site server contracts. Authenticated mutations require session and CSRF; the signed provider callback is separately public. Citizen fees and SaaS credits are separate. Production checkout defaults to disabled pending approved tenant merchant configuration; Nagad and bank payout reconciliation are not integrated. Official identity/signing remain unconfigured and certificates remain DEMO / NOT OFFICIAL. Source version does not establish hosted deployment or live merchant certification. Private attachments enter quarantine and require a hash-bound fresh ClamAV result before download, submission, approval or new issuance. The independently authenticated outbound scanner runs on the owner-selected PC; outages fail closed.

GatewayReceipt.description: Receipt and gateway confirmation commit atomically. PDF bytes and SHA-256 are stored permanently; retries return the original receipt. SANDBOX receipts are marked TEST PAYMENT / NO REAL MONEY COLLECTED. A payment receipt grants no certificate signing authority and is not bank payout evidence.

totalMinor.description: Integer BDT minor units; 100 = BDT 1.00. Separate from tenant SaaS credits.

eligible.description: True when the stored order has a positive fee, application state is APPROVED, and the office gateway is available. POST checkout performs additional current-payload approval checks and idempotency checks.

GatewayDailyReconciliation.description: Read-only totals; no daily cash closure or bank statement matching. Attempt counts/amounts use the selected Dhaka creation date; check counts use the verification date and may include repeated checks or earlier-created attempts. paidCount/paidMinor preserve historical verified payments. reviewCount also includes historically paid attempts with a later decisive mismatch, so review and paid categories can overlap. paidMinor is not bank-net payout.

amountMinor.description: Integer BDT minor units; 100 = BDT 1.00. Separate from tenant SaaS credits.

GatewayCheckDetails.description: Bounded expected/query/search financial fields recorded during a check. Query/search objects are absent if the earlier step could not complete. No credentials, wallet PIN, OTP or payer identity is exposed.

post.summary: Create or replay an approved application's bKash checkout
post.description: Citizen-own or current-office staff/admin only. Requires APPROVED current payload and a positive saved fee. The server supplies the amount, BDT currency, invoice, payer reference and callback URL; caller prices, status, tenant and redirect overrides are rejected. Same requestKey/actor/application replays; reuse for a different request conflicts. A second request key for the same application returns its existing intent. The durable create claim commits before the provider call; ambiguous outcomes become CREATE_UNKNOWN and never automatically trigger a second provider create. No wallet PIN or OTP is accepted. Unconfigured gateway fails before financial domain rows are inserted. This endpoint does not debit SaaS credits or issue a certificate.

post.summary: Reconcile one payment against bKash query and transaction search
post.description: Citizen-own or current-office staff/admin/finance. Provider query/search only; never execute. A completed query must match payment ID, amount, currency, invoice and sale intent; search additionally matches transaction ID and merchant. Both Completed responses are required for atomic confirmation/receipt. A later decisive MISMATCH holds new issuance as paymentStatus REVIEW_REQUIRED even when historical attempt.status remains PAID; original receipt stays immutable. Only a later MATCHED clears that hold, not ERROR/PENDING. Replayed requestKey returns its saved check; a concurrent in-progress replay returns 202 without another query. After the 60-second reservation window, recovery can query the same intent. At most 20 new checks per payment per five minutes. This is not bank payout settlement, refund or replacement checkout.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: When supplied on an authenticated mutation, must equal the configured PUBLIC_ORIGIN. X-CSRF-Token is required independently.

200.description: Durable verification result including MATCHED, MISMATCH, PENDING or ERROR; inspect result rather than treating HTTP 200 as paid.

202.description: The same request key has a verification claim less than 60 seconds old. Retry that same key; no new provider query or receipt is implied.

get.summary: Receive a provider-authenticated bKash browser callback
get.description: Public provider return route, mounted before session authentication; neither session cookie nor CSRF header is required. Requires the unguessable callback token plus the exact paymentID and create-time provider signature, compared against the persisted intent. Only success can claim execution, and only once from READY; the durable claim commits before execute, which is never retried after an ambiguous result. failure/cancel do not themselves mark paid or reverse a payment. Every accepted callback uses independent query/search verification; status=success alone cannot create a receipt. Redirect target is the fixed PUBLIC_ORIGIN with server-derived application/attempt IDs. The frontend return URL remains navigation, not payment evidence. Do not log or publish callback credentials.

303.description: Navigate to the fixed application payment return page after checking provider state; redirect is not proof of paid status.
